headline.purpose: Page titles (storefront results heading, console queue title); 20px on mobile.

headline-detail.purpose: Title atop a console detail pane.

body-table.purpose: Queue tables, console selects and textareas.

label.purpose: Field labels, column headers, filter-group headings; ink-muted, sentence case.

mono-small.purpose: Counts, IDs, sizes, hashes, ages, key hints.

shadows.name: float
shadows.purpose: Mobile mini player, the only element floating over content.

shadows.name: segment-thumb
shadows.purpose: Pressed button in a daylight segmented control.

shadows.name: knob-halo
shadows.purpose: Range-slider knobs cut out of the track.

shadows.name: scrim
shadows.purpose: Backdrop behind the mobile receipt sheet (background, not box-shadow).

shadows.name: stage-glow
shadows.purpose: Warm atmospheric wash on the stage card only.

shadows.name: top-bar-glass
shadows.value: background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--background) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(12px)

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The one easing curve: presses, sheets, toasts, beat decay.

motion.name: dur-fast
motion.purpose: Hover fills, press scales (buttons 0.97, stage play 0.93, row play 0.92).

motion.name: dur-slow
motion.purpose: Bottom sheet, scrim, mini player, toast.

motion.name: beat
motion.value: calc(60s / BPM), set as --beat on the root per selected track
motion.purpose: One clock: played bars scaleY 1.12 to 1, head bar 1.5 to 1, beat dot scale 1.7 to 1, each beat, only while playing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: No pulse, no slide; playhead and timecode update as plain state.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: <=1180: rail hidden, fluid centre plus 340px receipt.

breakpoints.name: max
breakpoints.purpose: Storefront content max width; console comps drawn at 1440.

components.css: .ds-search{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;height:44px;width:360px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 10px);background:var(--card, #1C1A17);border:1px solid var(--border, #2B2825);color:var(--muted-foreground, #9C968D);transition:border-color 120ms}.ds-search:focus-within{border-color:var(--fg-2, #CDC8BF)}.ds-search input{flex:1;background:none;border:0;outline:0;font:500 15px "Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;color:var(--foreground, #F2F0EB)}.ds-search input::placeholder{color:var(--muted-foreground, #9C968D)}.ds-search kbd{font:500 11px "Red Hat Mono",monospace;border:1px solid var(--border, #2B2825);border-radius:5px;padding:2px 6px}

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Mobile facet chip; selected inverts to ink.

components.name: Status Label
components.description: Dot plus label status, and the amber sample-data marker.
components.html: Ready 1 possible match Unavailable Sample data

components.name: Waveform Strip
components.description: Signature: idle bars warm grey, played bars tape orange, breathing on the one clock while playing.
components.css: .ds-wave{--beat:.65s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:3px;height:64px;width:420px}.ds-wave i{flex:1;border-radius:1px;background:var(--wave-idle, #47423C);transition:background 200ms}.ds-wave:hover i:not(.on){background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--wave-idle, #47423C) 55%,var(--muted-foreground, #9C968D))}.ds-wave i.on{background:var(--wave-played, #FF6A2B)}.ds-wave.is-playing i.on{animation:ds-breathe var(--beat) cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite}.ds-wave.is-playing i.head{animation:ds-beat var(--beat) cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) infinite}@keyframes ds-breathe{0%{transform:scaleY(1.12)}100%{transform:scaleY(1)}}@keyframes ds-beat{0%{transform:scaleY(1.5)}100%{transform:scaleY(1)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-wave i{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}}

components.name: License Receipt Lines
components.description: Exact GST lines under a dashed rule, mono amounts, total in the button.
components.css: .ds-receipt{width:320px;padding:18px 18px 16px;border-radius:var(--radius-lg, 18px);background:var(--card, #1C1A17);border:1px solid var(--border, #2B2825);color:var(--foreground, #F2F0EB);font:500 13px "Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-lines{border-top:1px dashed var(--input, #3A3631);padding-top:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}.ds-lines div{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;color:var(--fg-2, #CDC8BF)}.ds-lines div span:last-child{font-family:"Red Hat Mono",monospace}.ds-lines .ds-tot{color:var(--foreground, #F2F0EB);font-weight:700;font-size:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--border, #2B2825);padding-top:8px;margin-top:3px}.ds-pay{width:100%;height:46px;margin-top:12px;border:0;border-radius:var(--radius-sm, 10px);background:var(--primary, #F2F0EB);color:var(--primary-foreground, #141311);font:600 15px "Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}.ds-pay:hover{background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--primary, #F2F0EB) 88%,var(--background, #141311))}.ds-pay:active{transform:scale(.97)}.ds-pay:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--ring, #F2F0EB);outline-offset:2px}

components.name: Console Area Tabs
components.description: Admin top bar: wordmark with on-air dot, area tabs with ink underline, overdue counts in red.
components.css: .ds-areas{display:flex;align-items:stretch;gap:2px;height:52px;padding:0 20px;background:var(--card, #FFFFFF);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border, #E3E0DB);font:600 13px "Hanken Grotesk",system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-mark{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-right:18px;font-weight:700;font-size:17px;letter-spacing:-.03em;color:var(--foreground, #1A1815)}.ds-mark i{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--signal, #FF6A2B)}.ds-mark small{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--muted-foreground, #66615A)}.ds-areas a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:0 10px;color:var(--muted-foreground, #66615A);border-bottom:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer}.ds-areas a:hover{color:var(--foreground, #1A1815)}.ds-areas a[aria-current]{color:var(--foreground, #1A1815);border-bottom-color:var(--foreground, #1A1815)}.ds-areas a span{font-weight:500;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted-foreground, #66615A)}.ds-areas a span.hot{color:var(--blocked, #B82B27);font-weight:600}

narrative.overview:
The track's own sound is the cover. Every surface is a warm charcoal (or, for operators, warm daylight) room in which the loudest, brightest object is the playing track's waveform. There is no catalogue imagery and none is needed: a title set large and tight, a line of measured facts in mono, and a bar waveform that fills with tape orange as it plays carry the whole storefront. The same session continues into the seller portal and admin console with the house lights up: identical type, ink ramp, radii and single accent, on a light ground built for eight-hour queue work.

Density follows the job. The storefront is Persuade mode: one stage hero, a scannable results list, and a sticky license receipt that states the exact price with GST. The console is Operate mode: a queue table, a detail pane and a sticky decision bar, at 13 to 14px, where status, age and the next action read in one glance. Proof over promise governs both: the record, the tax lines, the status and the process are shown exactly, never dressed up.

Confirmed rejections: the category's look (hoopr.ai: pure black, hot-pink pills, AI cover art on every row, gradient subscription cards, sale banners, "no copyright claims" promises), the cover-art grid, the streaming-app clone, and the generic SaaS dashboard of KPI tiles and coloured sidebars.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal ground in stacked tonal steps (R >= G > B, never blue-black, never #000); warm off-white ink.
A named four-step ink ramp: ink, ink-2, ink-muted, ink-faint.
Neutral ink is the primary colour: every default button, checked control and focus ring is ink.
Tape orange belongs to sound alone, plus one sanctioned non-sound use: the wordmark's on-air light.
One clock: the playing waveform and beat dot pulse at the track's own tempo; silence is stillness.
Hanken Grotesk for all words, tight negative tracking at display size; Red Hat Mono only for measurements.
Flat, hairline-divided, softly rounded (6 to 18px); depth by tonal step, not shadow.

rules.name: The Sound-Only Rule
rules.body: Tape orange marks sound and nothing else: play while playing, played waveform, playhead or progress, beat dot, stage glow. The single exception is the wordmark's on-air light (the 8 to 9px dot beside the name). It never colours selection, links, primary actions, badges, focus or hover. A `signal` Button variant may be added only where sound is controlled.

rules.name: The Ink-Is-Primary Rule
rules.body: `--primary` and `--ring` are neutral ink, so every shadcn default renders ink, never orange. Test: put any shadcn primitive on the page with no variant; if it shows orange, the tokens are wrong.

rules.name: The Warm-Dark Rule
rules.body: Every dark value keeps R >= G > B. No #000 grounds, no blue-black, no cool greys. (A translucent black scrim over content is allowed; it is a shadow, not a ground.)

rules.name: The Measurements-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Red Hat Mono sets timecode, BPM, durations, prices and tax amounts, counts, IDs, hashes, sizes and ages, and nothing else. Words, names, statuses and labels stay in Hanken Grotesk.

rules.name: The No-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: No small uppercase or tracked kicker above a heading, anywhere. A heading stands alone; context goes in the sub-line beneath it.

rules.name: The Stage-First Rule
rules.body: On any storefront listing, the selected track's stage card (title, facts, play, License, full-width waveform, beat dot, timecode) is the first and largest object in the content column, above the list it belongs to.

rules.name: The One-Viewport Decision Rule
rules.body: The decision is reachable without scrolling: the receipt with its total and License action fits inside 1440x900; the console's decision bar is always pinned and visible.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Cards, rows, tables and panels never cast shadows. Only an element that physically floats over scrolling content (mini player, sheet, popover, toast) may lift.

rules.name: The One-Clock Rule
rules.body: All motion while a track plays runs on a single beat, `--beat = 60 / BPM` seconds, set once on the root when a track is selected. On each beat, played bars breathe from scaleY 1.12 to 1, the head bar from scaleY 1.5 to 1, and the beat dot from scale 1.7 to 1, all on the ease-out curve. Nothing else on the page pulses. When nothing plays, nothing moves; the beat dot rests at 35% opacity.

dos: **Do** keep every default control ink: shadcn Button, Badge, Checkbox, Radio, Switch, Slider, Progress and the focus ring take `--primary`/`--ring`, never tape orange.
**Do** reserve tape orange for sound (play while playing, played waveform, playhead, progress, beat dot, stage glow) plus the wordmark's on-air dot.
**Do** lead every storefront listing and track page with the stage: display title, facts, play, License and a full-width waveform.
**Do** run all playback motion on one clock (`--beat = 60/BPM`): played bars breathe at scaleY 1.12, the head bar at 1.5, and stop completely when audio stops or reduced motion is on.
**Do** show money exactly: license fee, CGST + SGST or IGST, total, all in Red Hat Mono from integer paise, and put the total in the button label.
**Do** show status as a 7px dot plus a word, and ages and due dates in mono, red when overdue.
**Do** state why an action is disabled, next to the disabled action, with a link to fix it.
**Do** mark every sample screen with the amber "Sample data" (or "Sample prices") marker and use fictional names for artists, sellers, rightsholders and admins.
**Do** describe clearance as a process ("our clearance desk takes it up with the rightsholder").
**Do** force the storefront route group dark and default seller and admin surfaces to light.
donts: **Don't** copy the category look of hoopr.ai: pure #000 grounds, hot-pink pills, AI cover art on every row, gradient subscription cards, sale banners.
**Don't** promise "no copyright claims", "zero strikes", "instant protection" or any guaranteed outcome.
**Don't** use eyebrow labels or uppercase tracked kickers above headings.
**Don't** build cover-art grids or album-tile layouts; there is no catalogue imagery, and the waveform is the cover.
**Don't** build KPI-tile dashboards, stat cards or coloured sidebars on seller or admin screens; use tables, receipt lines and dot-plus-label status.
**Don't** set words, names or statuses in Red Hat Mono; mono is for measurements only.
**Don't** use filled status banners or filled coloured badges.
**Don't** add drop shadows to cards, rows or panels at rest.
**Don't** use #000, blue-black or cool greys for any ground or surface.
**Don't** fabricate artists, testimonials, customer logos, sales numbers or press.
